question: Who among the following women cricketers has won the ICC Associate Player of the Decade award in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathryn Bryce.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathryn Bryce**__ is a national cricket player in Scotland's women's cricket team.

 __
 
• **She was selected as the ICC Associate Cricketer of the Decade in December 2020__**.
 
• She became the first cricketer from Scotland to reach the top ten of the ICC Player Rankings in June 2021.
 
• For her performance against Ireland in May 2021, Bryce was named the** ICC Women's Player of the Month.**
 
• She was the first Associate woman to be nominated for the award, and she was also the first Associate player to win it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stafanie Taylor** is the current captain of the West Indies women's cricket team.

 
 
• She became the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year in 2011.
 
 
 
• **Sarah Bryce** is a national cricket player in Scotland's women's cricket team.
 
 
• She was nominated for the ICC Women's Associate Cricketer of the Decade award in November 2020.
 
 
 
• **Mithali Raj** is the Test and ODI captain of the Indian women's national cricket team.
 
 
• She won the Wisden Leading Woman Cricketer in the World in 2017.
